issue.title: Retire agents_index_full_history
issue.description: TUI full-history agent loads read through the persistent artifact index before falling back to the source artifact scan.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The load-tiering epic has landed parity coverage for index-backed full history and the source-scan branch is no longer needed as a beta fallback.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: TUI full-history agent loads keep using the authoritative source artifact scan.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: TUI full-history agent loads query the persistent artifact index with the compiled candidate filter before decoding records.

payload.entry: Closed by sase-zu.8.5 acceptance. agents_index_full_history has no flag definition, registry entry, schema key or executable branch (grep over src/tests/tools/Justfile is empty); TUI full-history loads always read the revalidating artifact index and fall back to source scan only for missing/busy/failed index. Evidence on sase-core pin 23f19f0: production full-history oracle discovers post-build artifacts, drops deleted ones and claims complete_history only after Rust source reconcile; 13k synthetic production full history 0 missing / 0 extra; athena real archive production full history p50 2988.8 ms vs source scan 10866.4 ms (3.64x), 10-refresh session 12.6x with one full-history read. Published in docs/perf_runbook.md.
